units.source_text: 后来，至七月二十六日的第六轮续弈，白子用时八小时三十二分，黑子用时十二小时四十三分。

en.t: Later, by the sixth resumed session on July 26, White had used eight hours and thirty-two minutes, while Black had used twelve hours and forty-three minutes.

units.source_text: 至七月三十一日的第七轮，白子用时十小时三十一分，黑子用时十五小时四十五分。

en.t: By the seventh session on July 31, White had used ten hours and thirty-one minutes, while Black had used fifteen hours and forty-five minutes.
